opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected PhD in a historical subject to a UK institution, normally resident in the UK, not in full-time permanent academic employment, and current members of the Royal Historical Society. Current doctoral students are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £2,000 to support career-building research or activities post-PhD, enabling researchers to produce a discrete outcome (such as an article or book proposal).

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD in African history. Funding reserved for research projects clearly and predominantly historical in orientation with a specific chronological remit.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of £1,500 to support the doctoral research of a postgraduate researcher in African history, in memory of Professor Martin Lynn.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Historians who are members of the Royal Historical Society and who are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (within 5 years of completing a PhD). Priority given to those without access to other funding streams.
opportunities.summary: Awards of £500 or £1,000 to support historians without access to research funding to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend conferences.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History. Not open to those who have completed their doctoral degree.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to enable postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not conference attendance).

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected PhD in a historical subject, who are current members of the Royal Historical Society. Not open to postgraduate research students or those more than five years beyond PhD submission.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to enable early career historians to undertake research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not conference attendance).
